strategies.name: Detection of Compromise Software Supply Chain

analytics.name: Analytic 1853
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Compromise Software Supply Chain from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: Compromised app writes staging, cache, or export artifacts inconsistent with its declared function within $PostInstallWindow$]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Correlation window between install/update and subsequent runtime/network effects.
Approved managed or trusted applications vary by organization and device group.

analytics.name: Analytic 1854
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Compromise Software Supply Chain from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Launch services, extension-handling, or framework subsystem anomalies occur near install or first launch of recently updated trusted app on supervised device]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Correlation window between app install/update and subsequent lifecycle or network anomalies.
Strongest app inventory and managed state analytics depend on supervised iOS devices.
Approved managed app set varies by organization, business unit, and device profile.
Allowed upgrade paths, release rings, and phased rollout patterns vary by environment.
Expected app destinations, enterprise backends, Apple services, and CDNs differ by app.
Legitimate background activity differs by app category and policy.
Defines how close runtime/network activity must be to user action to be considered expected.
Threshold for suspicious post-update outbound transfer volume.
